title: Kessa Yard
note: Husks are drafts, kept in smoke/glow/silhouette until Enemy Design delivers final art.

panels.content: Garrison Nine (Warden cyan, Hale, Okafor, Brandt) on a walkway over Kessa Port at night

lines.speaker: caption
lines.text: Three days ago, the Deepwell drill hit something that bled. Kessa Port has been evacuating ever since.

panels.content: Civilians streaming to a cargo ship on the pier in rain, PA horns, orange glow on inland horizon

lines.speaker: announcer
lines.text: All civilians to the piers. Do not stop. Stay off open ground.

panels.content: Hale on radio (pale visor, whip antenna) beside Warden (cyan visor) in Kessa Yard

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: Last ship loads in twenty, Warden. Garrison Nine holds the yard till she’s gone.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: Then we hold the yard. Nobody gets left behind.

panels.content: Yard concrete ruptures, molten glow, container tipping; Husks only as smoky silhouettes in the fissure

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: Ground’s glowing... Contact! They’re coming up through the cracks!
